local seen = {} for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('BasePart') then local p = d.Position if p.X > 110 and p.X < 200 and p.Z > 820 and p.Z < 1000 and p.Y > 595 and p.Y < 700 and not d:IsDescendantOf(workspace.AsurasPath.Colosseums) then local key = d.Parent:GetFullName() .. '/' .. d.Name seen[key] = (seen[key] or 0) + 1 end end end local out = {} for k, v in seen do table.insert(out, k .. ' x' .. v) end table.sort(out) return table.concat(out, ' | '):sub(1, 3000)
